from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
repo = Path('.').resolve()
manifest = repo / 'PACKAGE_SHA256SUMS.txt'
entries = []
for line in manifest.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines():
    if line.strip():
        digest, rel = line.split('  ', 1)
        entries.append((digest, rel))
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='nicegui-base-chg59-clean-') as temp:
    staging = Path(temp)
    for _digest, rel in entries:
        source = repo / rel
        target = staging / rel
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(source, target)
    shutil.copy2(manifest, staging / manifest.name)
    results = {}
    for label, directory in [('worktree', repo), ('clean_staging', staging)]:
        for tool, args in [('shasum', ['-a','256','-c','PACKAGE_SHA256SUMS.txt']), ('sha256sum', ['-c','PACKAGE_SHA256SUMS.txt'])]:
            found = shutil.which(tool)
            if not found:
                results[f'{label}:{tool}'] = {'status':'NOT_AVAILABLE'}
                continue
            completed = subprocess.run([found, *args], cwd=directory, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
